metadataRaw.title: St. Joseph MI Chiropractor Gives the 3 Main Causes of Sciatica Pain
metadataRaw.description:
https://www.bestspinecare.com

In this quick video, Dr. Rowe goes over the three main causes of sciatica pain: disc herniations or bulges, piriformis syndrome, and spinal stenosis.

If you're suffering from shooting sciatic nerve pain into the thigh, leg, calf, foot, or toes... this is a MUST watch. It's extremely important to know what exactly is causing your sciatica pain, that way you can get the correct treatment plan.
